name: Secunda Reforged
source:
In the ancient dome of forbidden sorcery, within lands spoken out of world’s wound and sea of omens - you are Archone, a rapture-serpent of rapacious ages, a creature of all malice though equally so of elation - spoken into trope towards insatiable, sanguine and morbid scenery of heart. 

[From [url=https://vasilique-mort.itch.io/secunda-reforged]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在古老的禁忌巫术圆顶里，在从世界的伤口和预兆之海中说出的土地上——你是阿尔科恩，一条贪婪时代的狂喜之蛇，一个充满恶意但同样狂喜的生物——用比喻来比喻永不满足、乐观和病态的心灵风景。

[来自[url=https://vasilique-mort.itch.io/secunda-reforged]itch.io[/url]]
